data.name: Nehita
data.long_meaning: Nehita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Neha', which means 'mind' or 'heart'. The suffix '-ita' denotes the one who embodies or possesses the qualities described by the prefix. Thus, Nehita is the one who embodies the nectar of the gods, symbolizing divine grace and spiritual purity.

Therefore, the name Nehita may be perceived as a reminder of the importance of maintaining a pure heart and mind.
